# /crav1-repos-to-spec

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From named repos to an architecture spec](../../from-repos.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-repos-to-spec/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Read one or more repos the user named.

## Runs when

The user names the repos. Called by the user and by [`/crav1-environment-read`](crav1-environment-read.md) for a confirmed architecture or left-out section.

This is one of the seven starter options. Asking for startup options names it and does not run it.

## Reads

In short: Those repos, and left-out when present.

Reads the repos the user named, and `docs/architecture/left-out.md` when that file is there.

## Writes

In short: `docs/architecture/spec.md` when missing, `docs/architecture/left-out.md`, the system notes when missing, and `Synced at` on each repo it read.

Writes `docs/architecture/spec.md` when that file is missing, `docs/architecture/left-out.md` for guesses that stay left out, and the `docs/system/` notes [`/crav1-explain`](crav1-explain.md) reads when those notes are missing. Sets `Synced at` on each repo it read and touches only those repos.

## Does not

Leaves application code and the next feature alone. On the pass that creates the architecture spec while system notes are already there, that cell is the only edit to those notes.

Limits and exceptions: before writing, one question per section (each named repo, inferred guesses, links, left-out) and every item stays listed. A later re-read adds only what is new to the spec and notes, sets `Synced at` for repos it read without rewriting the rest of that row, and removes a left-out line when the code shows it or that section dismisses it. A guess stays out until that section accepts it. A link is written only when the code shows it.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls [`/crav1-feature-branch`](crav1-feature-branch.md) when the destination already has commits.

## Lane and group

Lane: Cross-cutting. Group: Start. Starter option: yes. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).

## Stage and since

Stage: stable. Since: 1.9.0 ([changelog](../../../CHANGELOG.md)).

## First prompt

```text
/crav1-repos-to-spec
@repo-a/
@repo-b/

Read these repos. Write one architecture spec and the system notes.
A guess stays out until I confirm it. Do not invent a link. Do not write code.
```
